column1: # Reviewed guard expectations: one line per guard, sorted by path.
# This file is committed; neither the checker nor the generator writes it.
# Numeric fields match exactly in both directions, preserving assertion/honesty ratchets.
# entry_sha256 locks EVERY canonical per-entry field, including full wiring, protects,
# blastRadius, criticalReasons, honesty details, and any future schema fields.
# The registry metadata digest locks its shared rule configuration; counts are checked live.
# Object key order and registry entry order are non-semantic; nested array order is semantic.
# For an intentional guard change, review its diff and use --suggest <path> to update its row.
# "-" is only for unavailable numeric metadata or absent ownership; critical guards require owners.
